scope: local x86_64 CPU in-process simulation with cpp_native planner; no ROS DDS, ARM64 board, NPU or vehicle
changes: adaptive Hybrid A* planning margins: primary reserve, 0.08m, then execution guard 0.06m; every path is rechecked against the execution guard
wall-return rejection margin raised from 0.06m to 0.20m to remove perimeter artifacts from the planning map
standard preset corner speed 0.25 m/s, lookahead 0.18m and shift pause 0.20s to reduce stop/restart cycles
raw-scan body-clearance emergency stop at 0.03m for a missed/delayed detection
short rear-clearance/swept-footprint checked reverse arc for start-in-collision and repeated no-path states
not_verified: vehicle braking, steering calibration or track completion
formal completeness on arbitrary random minefields
